entities.summary: Giovanni Sercambi was an Italian author from Lucca who wrote a history of his city, Le croniche di Luccha, as well as Il novelliere, a collection of 155 tales. Born in the late 14th century, Sercambi's works offer valuable insights into the cultural and social landscape of medieval Lucca. His chronicle, published in 1400, is one of the earliest surviving accounts of the city's history and provides a unique perspective on the politics, economy, and daily life of the region during this period. Through his writing, Sercambi not only contributed to the city's cultural heritage but also helped to preserve its history for future generations. As a result, his works have become an important source of information for historians and scholars studying the medieval period in Italy.
